reviewsSummary.failureDetails: memory-self-improve-skill FAILED because the assigned worker session (30d79c3a) implemented the wrong feature (memory-reflection-upgrade instead of self_improve skill). However, the actual self_improve skill code EXISTS in the codebase (commit c62347d, backend/skills/self_improve/) created by session 642b54f2 under the memory-consolidation handoff. All 20 self_improve tests pass. This is a process/attribution issue, NOT a missing code issue. The self_improve skill is fully functional.

nonBlockingIssues.description: Worker session attribution swap: session 30d79c3a (assigned memory-self-improve-skill) delivered memory-reflection-upgrade code, while session 642b54f2 (assigned memory-consolidation) delivered self_improve skill code. Both features exist and work, but handoff metadata is wrong for both.

Double confidence decay: existing memory-prune task (2 AM) and new memory-consolidation task (3 AM) both apply 0.95 decay to stale memories, resulting in effective 0.9025 daily decay instead of 0.95. The prune task should be updated to skip decay/prune now that consolidation handles it.

Two competing LearningLogManager classes: core/memory/learning_logs.py (new, DB-backed with raw SQL) and core/intelligence/learning_logs.py (pre-existing, system_knowledge-backed with auto-detection). Both actively imported by different modules. Should be unified or documented.

Test-specific normalization hacks in PromotionEngine._normalize_text(): strips '__\w+__' and '\bv\d+\b' patterns to accommodate test markers. Could affect production similarity matching for content with double-underscore patterns or version numbers.

Excessive DB engine creation: PromotionEngine._get_session(), MemoryConsolidator._get_session(), and ContextAssembler._get_promoted_learnings() all create new async engines per call instead of using the shared AsyncSessionLocal factory.
No deduplication of corrections/gaps across daily reflection runs. If the same conversation is analyzed multiple times, identical LEARNINGS/ERRORS entries will be created.
Commit 81502ab bundles unrelated Celery tasks (news-newsletter, reflection-agent, site-watcher, ml-skill-analysis, code-quality-sweep) beyond feature scope.
